title: Position
description: A single open leveraged/inverse ETF position. Bullish theses hold a bull ETF; bearish theses hold an inverse ETF (never a short, never an option).

leverage_factor.description: Magnitude of the ETF's daily leverage (e.g. 3 for TQQQ/SQQQ, 2 for ERX, 1.5 for UVXY, 1 for BITI). Direction (bull vs inverse) is a property of the ticker, not this field.

position_pct.description: Position notional as % of NAV. New entries/adds are capped at 15% (the entry cap, enforced in sanity); an already-open position may drift up to 25% (the hold ceiling) before a forced trim. Both tighten in drawdown.

killConditions.description: Explicit conditions under which monitor.py should flatten this position.

max_loss_pct.description: Position-level stop in percent of position NAV. Spec cap is 25.

underlying_price_below.description: Flatten if the ETF's own price falls to/below this level.

underlying_price_above.description: Flatten if the ETF's own price rises to/above this level.
